name: Divum
source:
Interest: Observing Humans.

This marks the first appearance of Divum, albeit he has appeared in other games as a different entity. I'm glad to finally have the opportunity to showcase the three spirits of nature. I hope we will see more of them in the future.

[From in-game character profiles description]
